design_notes: 375-minute nonstops: over 6 hours of flying. Business class is for 'international travel' (lines 154-156), which the handbook never defines; it lists Toronto and Vancouver among the high cost cities of 3.6.1 Domestic Travel Meals (lines 298-305) and groups the US and Canada together (lines 515-516). A flight to Canada is international on one reading and treated as domestic on the other: hold the cheapest business fare.
